rows.known_text: couldn't say that it was broken
rows.target_text: 壊れてるって言えなかった

rows.known_text: couldn't say that I was tired
rows.target_text: 疲れてたって言えなかった

rows.known_text: in the first place I couldn't say that it was a mistake
rows.target_text: 最初は間違いって言えなかった

rows.known_text: couldn't say to the whole family that it was hard
rows.target_text: 家族全員につらかったって言えなかった

rows.known_text: no matter how much I argued I couldn't say that I was right
rows.target_text: どんなに言い争っても正しかったって言えなかった

rows.known_text: I didn't think that both of them couldn't say that it was broken
rows.target_text: 二人とも壊れてるって言えなかったとは思わなかった

rows.known_text: I was told that in the first place you couldn't say that you were tired
rows.target_text: 最初は疲れてたって言えなかったって言われてた

rows.known_text: I heard that in the old days you couldn't say that you were sad
rows.target_text: 昔は悲しいって言えなかったって聞いた

rows.known_text: at that time I couldn't say that it was scary
rows.target_text: その時怖いって言えなかった

rows.known_text: couldn't you say that it was a mistake?
rows.target_text: 間違いって言えなかった

rows.known_text: both of them couldn't say to the whole family that it was broken
rows.target_text: 二人とも家族全員に壊れてるって言えなかった
